ComicsGate Kings devoted a sustained segment to Chrissie Mayr's departure. Ethan framed it as a consequence of the Melanie Mack/TheQuartering dispute and said the FNT side felt unable to bring her back. Other panelists questioned the practical value of waiting to be fired and described her fit with the show negatively. These are panel interpretations, not an independent confirmation of the employment arrangement.
